+def detect_bottle_and_xyz(obs):
+    """Find the isolated maroon bottle in the wrist RGB and deproject depth."""
+    cam = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
+    rgb = np.asarray(obs.last[cam])
+    depth = last_depth(obs, cam).astype(float)
+    # The bottle is reddish-brown; the orange counter has much higher green.
+    R, G, B = rgb[..., 0], rgb[..., 1], rgb[..., 2]
+    mask = ((R > 38) & (R > 1.3 * G) & (R > 1.18 * B) & (G < 125) & (B < 115))
+    roi = np.zeros_like(mask)
+    roi[60:145, 65:150] = True
+    mask &= roi
+    # Select the largest connected component in the local wrist-camera region.
+    seen = np.zeros_like(mask)
+    best = []
+    for yy, xx in zip(*np.nonzero(mask)):
+        if seen[yy, xx]:
+            continue
+        stack, component = [(int(yy), int(xx))], []
+        seen[yy, xx] = True
+        while stack:
+            y, x = stack.pop()
+            component.append((y, x))
+            for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
+                if 0 <= ny < 240 and 0 <= nx < 320 and mask[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]:
+                    seen[ny,nx] = True

+        if len(component) > len(best):

+    if len(best) < 20:

+    pix = np.asarray(best, dtype=int)
+    # Use the color component's central pixels; this keeps bottle edges and

+    cy, cx = np.median(pix, axis=0)
